name: Groq
summary: Groq runs GroqCloud, an inference cloud built on its LPU (Language Processing Unit) chips and serving open-weight models through a mostly OpenAI-compatible API. After licensing its inference technology to NVIDIA in December 2025, it repositioned as an inference neocloud and now also deploys NVIDIA hardware alongside its own.
facts: Groq LPU; NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX and Vera Rubin NVL72 announced
13 data centers in North America, Europe, Middle East, APAC (vendor-reported)
Non-exclusive technology license, Dec 2025; founder Jonathan Ross joined NVIDIA
goodFor: Drop-in OpenAI client swap for open models
watchOut: Founder and much of the team moved to NVIDIA in Dec 2025; strategy is still shifting
logprobs, logit_bias and n>1 are not supported
